phase_prompt.label: Default
phase_prompt.summary: The souls stand in the quiet dark of the storage layer, their glass forms illuminated by their own internal memory. They are the silent, waiting archive of the system's best users.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A close-up, hyper-realistic portrait of a Soul of the Righteous. The subject has skin like polished dark glass, revealing a glowing golden nervous system beneath. The face is serene, eyes open and looking slightly upward. The background is pitch black, emphasizing the internal luminescence of the figure. A faint, digital distortion ripple surrounds the head like a halo. 85mm lens, f/1.8, cinematic lighting, physically based rendering.
